name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
short_description: Lead a party of heroes through endless dungeon loops. Gather loot, unlock permanent upgrades, and build powerful synergies as you push deeper into an ever-growing incremental adventure.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Loot +18
現在プレイヤー500人以上 +10

name: Tall Orders
short_description: Tall Orders is a co-op platforming game where you and a friend play as small gnomes tending to a wizard's potion shop for the day. Work together to overcome your size, find the right ingredients, and brew potions. But beware, handling the ingredients may cause strange side effects!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Starship Horizons: Bridge Simulator
short_description: Starship Horizons is a multi-player experience allowing 2-6 players commanding a Starship as the bridge officers in the roles of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Science, Operations, and Engineering.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Shark Tales: Reef Rogues
short_description: Small fins. Big trouble. Battle underwater swarms solo, in four-player local co-op or Steam online co-op. Evolve oddball weapons, hunt buried stories and outfit a crew that looks as strange as it fights.
reasons: 次点ジャンル: Online Co-op +30

name: Patients
short_description: Psychological horror with a retro atmosphere,solo or co-op experience for 2 or more players,Inventory and, resource management, interactive and explorable environment, unpredictable events

name: Same Apartment
short_description: Same Apartment is a story-driven psychological horror game unfolding across twelve days. Explore a constantly changing apartment, follow disturbing broadcasts, read notes, and confront fragmented memories as the boundary between reality and delusion slowly disappears.

name: GemLoop
short_description: GemLoop is a match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Progression +20
成長/積み上げ要素: Skill Tree +15

name: Big Dig
short_description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー500人以上 +10

name: Warding Witches
short_description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Howling Woods
short_description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Futa Fitness 🤸‍♀️
short_description: Kyla is a hot blonde chick, the kind guys stare at in the gym. But what has her so captivated is her idol, Mara, and Mara’s exposed futa cock! If only she could get her hands – and mouth! – on that fine thick meat! Mara’s a serious gym fiend, but can Kyla convince her to try another type of workout?
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Blue Artifact +
short_description: "Blue Artifact" is a side-scrolling action game where Fran, a girl awakened deep underground in a research facility, uses magic to escape. Collect “treasures” within the facility to uncover the secrets of the research lab.

name: Todd is Late
short_description: Todd is Late is a FMV point and click hidden-object game that pits you not only against the clock, but also against your own ability to plan and adapt with every attempt. Help guide Todd out the door with everything he needs in time for his big day at work.

name: Coin Harvest
short_description: Robotic arms sweep a steady pour of coins off your plateau. Unlock islands, conquer six realms and ascend for crystals in an idle game that sits on your desktop while you work or play.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー100人以上 +8

name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
short_description: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
short_description: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Liberation Through Hearing
short_description: An interactive opera based on computer game technologies. An audio-visual, large-scale work that combines a dramatic story, taking place in digital media, with game-like elements. Hand drawings and composed music constitute the main fabric of the opera.

name: Ice Cream Hero
short_description: Ice Cream Hero is a sweet tower defense challenge for one to four players. Team up with friends or play solo as Nilla, a brave little ice cream hero defending his land’s precious Sprinkle Bank from hungry silverware, chaotic waves, and big bad bosses.

name: Parry X Break
short_description: Designed for high replay value and quick restarts, Parry X Break is a fast paced spin on the brick breaker genre where the ball goes faster every time you parry it. Parrying speeds up the ball, raises your point multiplier, and levels up your ball so you can break locked bricks.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
short_description: Run a sports agency, not a team. Recruit stars across four leagues, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, survive scandals and holdouts, then retire to an interactive career review and post your score to the monthly global leaderboard. Premium, no microtransactions.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: AimZen
short_description: AimZen is a minimalist first-person aim trainer with stackable hotkey-activated modifiers, built to sharpen precision, reaction speed, and muscle memory.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Ladykiller in a Bind - Ladykiller Unleashed
short_description: After ten years the Beast, the original lesbian ladykiller, is finally back! Featuring new characters, threesomes with old love interests, the return of the critically acclaimed dialogue system... and of course, lots of sex.

name: FORGEFIELD
short_description: Live wallpapers and screensavers for Windows, featuring nine animated worlds rendered in real time. Explore black holes, auroras and glowing embers. Choose a world, adjust its visual settings, and enjoy it on your desktop or in fullscreen.

name: Pareidolia
short_description: Confront the games your own mind plays on you deep within a remote forest. Step out of your tent, set up your cameras, and gather clues. Remember: those silhouettes you see in the shadows might not just be your paranoia. The darkest corner of your mind is your deadliest enemy.

name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
short_description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

name: It'll Hold
short_description: Play poker hands to build a tower of cards, one floor at a time. Each hand lays a floor piece on the plot. Stack matching suits straight up to grow your multiplier, beat every floor's target and hire a crew on your coffee break. Miss a target and the lot comes down.

name: Big Dig - Supporter Pack
short_description: This Supporter Pack is for you if you love Big Dig and want to help support Hjalte and Schu make more games! It adds a French dog named Adrien who helps you redecorate your Museum! Plus a statue with YOUR name on it!

name: Number Go Up
short_description: Number Go Up is a clicker, incremental game. It is exactly how it sounds, click buttons, buy upgrades, ascend, rebirth, reset your progress incrementally. And watch as the number on your screen rises faster and faster, achieving new heights. Throw on a video and relax as you watch your Number Go Up.

name: Resonance
short_description: Resonance is a relaxing virtual handpan experience. Play intuitively with your keyboard, explore a variety of scales, shape your sound with effects and ambience, record and share what you create. A peaceful way to unwind after a long day.

name: The Book
short_description: No accounts, no stores, no distractions. Bring the books you already own — EPUB, PDF, TXT, HTML, CBZ, CBR and image folders — and read them as 3D books.
